text.jp:
敵の動きが無いように見えて、逆に
こちらの様子を伺っている可能性もござります。
text.official_en:
In my experience, when your enemy appears not to
be making a move, they're likely inquiring after you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
特に……それがしには、このように
静かなときは、逆に不気味に感じます。
text.official_en:
Which is why quiet times like these make me feel
most uneasy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
姫、わかっておいでとは思いまするが、
くれぐれも油断なさらぬよう。
text.official_en:
You mustn't let your guard down, milady—not that I
have to remind you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
我が主が貴女の復讐をお認めになられた以上、
おれの腹も決まったというもの。
text.official_en:
Now that my lady assents to your planned revenge,
I will do likewise.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
レダ嬢、おれも貴女のために
いっそうの協力を約束しよう。
text.official_en: You shall continue to have my support, Miss Leda.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
無事にすべてを果たし、
復讐から貴女を解き放つことこそが、
text.official_en:
I will see this through with you—and help release
you from this unmet desire.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
おれの、主に対し
忠義を果たす事になる、というわけさ。
text.official_en: For that is what my loyalty to my lady requires.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
大人ってみんな、ゴーシュが好きだよね。
ボクにはまだあの良さはわからないかな。
text.official_en:
Adults really love ghosh, huh? I just don't get what
the fuss is about.
text.real_en:
Adults really love gauche, huh? I just don't get what
the fuss is about.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あれだったら、絞ったギンジの果汁に
蜂蜜を垂らしたやつのほうが好きだよ。
text.official_en:
You give me some freshly squeezed ginji juice with
a drizzle of honey, and then we're talking!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それが、よく冷えてたりすると
もう最高なんだけど……あれ？
text.official_en:
It's the best, especially after it's chilled awhile.
Wait—hmmm.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ちょっとまって……そういえばゴーシュに
グルマオサの汁を混ぜたらどうなるんだろう？
text.official_en:
I wonder what ghosh would taste like if you mixed in
a dash of glirmosa juice.
text.real_en:
I wonder what gauche would taste like if you mixed in
a dash of glirmosa juice.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
考えてたら気になってきちゃった。
あとで試してみなくちゃ！
text.official_en: This has got me thinking. I've gotta try that!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
若いゴーシュを探すなら、やはり
酒場に行ってみるのがいいのではないかしら。
text.official_en:
I suspect you'd have luck finding young ghosh if
you went to the tavern.
text.real_en:
I suspect you'd have luck finding young gauche if
you went to the tavern.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグシオンの酒場は、かなり早いうちから
新しいゴーシュを扱い始めるらしいですわ。
text.official_en: The taverns in Dagsion begin stocking it quite early.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
妾がかつて薔薇祭で、其方に最年少で
カエルスの薔薇の称号を与えたのは、
text.official_en:
When I awarded you the title "Rose of Caelus,"
making you the youngest person to receive the title...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何も、其方がコーエンの末裔だったから
という訳ではないことは、理解してほしい。
text.official_en:
I hope you know it was not because you are
descended from Cohen.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
妾は、あのときの其方のビウエラに、
それだけの力を感じたのだ。
text.official_en:
It was because of the raw strength I could hear when
you played the vihuela.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
きっと、我が息子コーエンが道半ばで
命を絶つこと無くビウエラを極めていたら、
text.official_en:
My son Cohen was not able to reach such mastery
without losing his life.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
きっと、このような演奏をしたに違いないと……
そのときの妾は感じたのだ。
text.official_en:
If he could, he'd have performed as you did.
That is how I felt.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それほどに、其方のビウエラは情熱的で、
皆の心を激しく打っていたのだ。
text.official_en:
The passion of your playing—the ferocity of it—
pierced the hearts of all who listened.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アンナの顔を最後に見たのは、
それがしがこの帝都を去る頃だったから――
text.official_en:
The last time I saw Anna was the day I left the
imperial capital.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
確か、１４２５年の……
とすればすでに２４年になりますな。
text.official_en:
Back in 1425, if memory serves...which means it's
already been 24 years.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いや、彼女の、昔と全く変わらぬ様子には
それがしも驚きました。
text.official_en:
And yet, much to my surprise, it seems she hasn't
aged a day.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
仮に半神としても、それだけの期間、全く印象が
変わらぬなどということ……あるのでしょうか。
text.official_en:
One would expect even a demigod to come across
differently after all that time...right?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レダ嬢、おれはこれまでの人生の中で
実に様々な人間の姿を見てきた。
text.official_en:
Miss Leda, in the course of my life, I've become
familiar with a wide variety of people.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
真に気をつけねばならないのは、
表面上の善人、悪人などではない。
text.official_en:
I believe the one we're looking for is not someone
who appears outwardly good or bad...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それは、物事をうまく先導して、裏側から
自分の望む方向に仕向けようとする者だ。
text.official_en:
but someone who's skilled at staying hidden and
guiding events toward their own desired outcome.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おれは、今回の一連の事件の背後に、
そういう者の影を感じる気がするのだ。
text.official_en:
I sense the shadow of such an entity behind these
recent events.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
君ですらも、そいつによって
動かされているかもしれないのだ。
text.official_en:
Who knows? They may even be influencing your
own actions.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いいかね、レダ嬢……
人の表層の姿に惑わされぬようにすることだ。
text.official_en:
Tread carefully, Miss Leda. And do not let yourself
be taken in by appearances.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
うちのお母さん、ボクがスミルノス様の神殿に
お仕えするために魔道の知識が必要だって、
text.official_en:
My mom said that I needed to know about magic to
work at Smyrnos's temple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
偉い魔道士に弟子入りするためにお金が
要るんだって出稼ぎにでちゃったんだけど……
text.official_en:
So, she left home to make money for me to
apprentice under a big-shot mage.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ボクがカーラ様の神殿に出入りしてるってこと、
早く教えてあげたほうがいいのかなあ……
text.official_en:
I should probably tell her sooner rather than later
that I'm at Kalla's temple...
text.real_en:
I should probably tell her sooner rather than later
that I'm at Cara-sama's temple...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、今更どんな顔して
切り出したらいいかわからないし……
text.official_en: But I'm not sure how to bring it up after all this time.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だいたい、うちのお母さんはこっちの気持ちも
知らないで、なんでも決めつけるんだから！
text.official_en:
I mean, Mom keeps making decisions for me without
stopping once to think about how I feel!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……思い出したらだんだん腹が立ってきちゃった。
やっぱりあの人には教えないでおこう。
text.official_en:
Ugh, it's so frustrating. Yeah, no, I'm not telling her
a thing.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ううう……曲が……全く浮かばない……
締切が迫ってくるというのに……
text.official_en:
Ohhh... I can't think of a melody, and the deadline is
fast approaching.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やはり、あたくし、今回は
肩に力が入りすぎているのかしら……
text.official_en:
Perhaps the pressure I'm feeling is impeding my
creative abilities.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こ、このままではあたくしのみならず、
カーラ神殿の名誉にも関わってしまう……
text.official_en:
But if I don't succeed, it won't just be my own
reputation I hurt. I'll damage the temple's as well!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
レ……レイリダーナ……本当はあなたなんかに
こんなこと頼みたくないのですけど……
text.official_en:
Leilidahna...you know I'm loathe to ask for your
assistance with such a task.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
一生のお願いだから、この曲の制作、
手伝っていただけませんこと……！？
text.official_en:
But please, just this once, would you help me
compose a song?!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
――！？
お前はあの時の女！
text.official_en: *gasp* You— You're the girl!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……心配するな。こんなところで
騒ぎを起こすのは本意ではない。
text.official_en: None of us wants to cause a scene.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
俺が目を閉じている間に
どこかに消えるがいい。
text.official_en:
I'll just close my eyes, and you'll run off and
disappear. Alright?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まったく、あれだけのことをしておいて
よく平然と街をうろつけるものだ。
text.official_en:
Rather bold, strolling around the city without a care.
After the stunt you pulled!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……そうだな、褒めていると
受け取ってもらっても別に構わない。
text.official_en: Take that as a compliment if you like.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
貴方のような女性とは……
また違った形で出会いたかったものだ。
text.official_en:
Under different circumstances, we might not have
been on opposing sides.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アンナはかなり古くから
神威法王の下で仕える神官だ。
text.official_en:
Anna has served at the Divine Sovereign's side as a
priest for quite some time now.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いや……それは表向きは
伏せられている事であったかもしれんが。
text.official_en:
Though...I realize that may have been hidden
from the public.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえば……いつからだったろうな。
アンナの姿を見かけ始めたのは。
text.official_en: I wonder, when was it I first laid eyes on Anna?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
正確なところは覚えていないが……
かなり昔からだったのは確かだ。
text.official_en: Hmm, I can't recall, but I know it was long ago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まあ、あ奴にも思うところがあって
あのように振舞っているのであろう。
text.official_en:
I'm sure she has her reasons for behaving the way
she does.
